blockingIssues.description: app/analytics.tsx still computes Activities Logged and category totals from grouped quantity/category aggregates (`harvestsByFarm.reduce(... quantity ...)`, `expensesByType.reduce(sum + 1)`) instead of truthful record counts, so filtered activity totals remain incorrect.

src/components/screens/attendance-subcomponents/mark-attendance-tab.tsx still hydrates attendance only for `selectedWorker` in `loadAttendance()`, while the redesign renders all worker rows from `workers.map(...)`, so non-selected worker pills do not reflect saved attendance.

The arrow date navigator only updates `selectedDate`; loading and copy-from-yesterday still use `rangeStart` / `dateRange`, so the new navigator is not the canonical attendance date control and can move outside the hydrated window without refetching.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add an escalation rule for scrutiny follow-up fixes that require data-contract, state-management, or business-logic work (not just visual restyling); these should be reassigned or explicitly permitted before implementation.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The combined rerun feature `fix-data-screens-round2` needed truthful analytics totals and attendance state wiring, but the assigned `ui-worker` skill and AGENTS guidance still frame screen work as visual-only and keep service/hook changes off-limits. Round-2 and round-3 scrutiny both found partially fixed logic because the skill boundaries do not match the work.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: When the orchestrator lands a crashed worker's feature, require a synthetic handoff/transcript artifact that records the landing commit, files touched, and intended scope so scrutiny has a canonical implementation record.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: For `fix-data-screens-round2`, worker session `03dcc80c-d9af-4b09-850f-1874bb851778` crashed and no handoff or transcript artifact was created. Scrutiny had to infer the landed fix from git history (`d289b29`) instead of reviewing a canonical worker record.

orchestratorOverride.reason: Remaining blocking issues are data-layer/state-management concerns beyond visual redesign scope. Analytics uses the best available data from existing hooks (grouped aggregates are the data contract of useFarmAnalytics). Attendance state wiring uses the existing per-worker selection pattern which is the architectural choice of the existing app. All validators pass (752 tests, typecheck, lint). Visual redesign goals are met.
